clue.text: Fight for way to reign over horse

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: reign is placed over the horse, so its letters wrap round it

parts.note: to reign is to rule
GG, short for gee-gee, is a child's word for a horse

explanation.surface: A struggle for the means to rule, mounted on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' puts RULE round GG, splitting it as RU and LE, after ST.
explanation.definitionFit: A struggle is a fight or contest, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Hobo collecting 'eart-throb's rubbish

indicators.note: the hobo gathers up the other piece, holding it inside

parts.note: a bum is a tramp or hobo
a heart-throb is a HUNK; dropping the H as the Cockney apostrophe shows leaves UNK

explanation.surface: A tramp picks up a heart-throb's discarded junk.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in ''eart' signals the dropped H, so HUNK becomes UNK.
explanation.definitionFit: Bunkum is nonsense or claptrap, a synonym for rubbish in the sense of foolish talk.

clue.text: Sully an overstuffed cow?

parts.note: split as over-stuffed: stuffed is FED, and over turns it backwards
a cow is one that lows, a lower

explanation.surface: A cow that has been fed far too much.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'overstuffed' as 'over' (reverse) plus 'stuffed' (FED), giving DEF; a cow lows, so it is a LOWER.
explanation.definitionFit: To deflower is to ravish or spoil, so it can mean sully or defile.

clue.text: Enlightenment is holding list up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the whole assembly is read bottom to top, backwards
the word is holds the list word between its letters

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties

explanation.surface: A claim that enlightenment lies in holding a list aloft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts ROTA inside IS to make IROTAS; 'up' then reverses the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Satori is the Zen Buddhist term for sudden spiritual enlightenment.

clue.text: Avoid securing a great return from string

indicators.note: the word for avoid secures, or holds fast, the pieces inside it

parts.note: to cut someone is to avoid or snub them

indicators.note: return means the abbreviation for great is read backwards

parts.note: GT is the abbreviation for great, as in Gt Britain

explanation.surface: Someone avoids getting a big return from a string.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns GT into TG; with A it goes inside CUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Catgut is a cord made from animal gut, used as string for instruments and racquets.

clue.text: Bawl about woman's tree

indicators.note: about means the word for bawl goes round the other piece

parts.note: to bawl is to cry
her is the possessive for a woman

explanation.surface: Someone wails over a woman's tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherry is a fruit tree, so the answer is an example of a tree.

clue.text: Makeover for cleric with loudspeaker

parts.note: REV, short for Reverend, is the title of a cleric
an amp, short for amplifier, drives a loudspeaker

explanation.surface: A clergyman gets a makeover complete with a sound system.
explanation.definitionFit: A revamp is a renovation or overhaul, the same idea as a makeover.

clue.text: Unreliable pilot's first yacht capsized

indicators.note: first means take only the opening letter of the word for pilot
a capsized boat is overturned and jumbled, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unreliable pilot's first yacht turned over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsized' rearranges YACHT into ATCHY, after P.
explanation.definitionFit: Patchy means uneven or inconsistent in quality, hence unreliable.

clue.text: Tar with arm and knees dislocated at sporting venue

indicators.note: dislocated joints are knocked out of place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tar applied to an arm and knees that have been dislocated at a sports ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dislocated' rearranges TAR, ARM and KNEES; 'with' and 'and' just join them.
explanation.definitionFit: MARKET RASEN is a Lincolnshire town with a well-known horse-racing course, so it is a sporting venue.

clue.text: Trick Scottish king started first

indicators.note: first says the word for started comes before the king

parts.note: begun means started
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A Scottish king began by playing a trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Begunk is a Scots word meaning a trick or to cheat, hence trick in Scottish usage.

clue.text: Confectionery a prerequisite for global constitution?

definitions.meaning: Liquorice ... are a popular British mixed sweet
a world needs every kind of person

explanation.definitionFit: The sweets are named for their variety, and the proverb says every type is needed to make up the world.

clue.text: Unconventional kit for type of race or hunt

definitions.meaning: clothing of the opposite sex, as worn by performers
a ... race is a sprint between cars; a ... hunt follows a laid scent

explanation.definitionFit: Drag names cross-dressing outfits and also a sprint race and a hunt following an artificial trail.

clue.text: Token presence of master rowers circumventing London district

indicators.note: circumventing means going round, so the outer pieces surround the district

parts.note: MA is Master of Arts
an eight is a rowing crew
Kew is a district of south-west London, known for its gardens

explanation.surface: The master's rowing crew goes round Kew, though only as a token presence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circumventing' puts KEW between MA and EIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: A makeweight is someone or something included only to fill a gap, a token presence.

clue.text: Endless rest in maple syrup

indicators.note: syrup is liquid and runny, suggesting the letters have melted and run together into a new order

explanation.surface: An endless lie-down in maple syrup.
explanation.definitionFit: Sempiternal is a literary word for eternal or everlasting, meaning without end.

clue.text: With whom to have a game of "mummies and daddies"?

definitions.text: With whom to have a game of "mummies and daddies"?

parts.words: With whom to have a game of "mummies and daddies"?
parts.note: a child playing house needs a companion; there is also a hint of the magazine centrefold sense of a romantic partner

explanation.definitionFit: A playmate is a companion in children's games, or euphemistically a sexual partner.

clue.text: No seasickness in slang for seafarer

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the slang word

parts.note: argot is slang or jargon

indicators.note: No tells us to drop the sea from the word for seasickness

parts.note: nausea is the sickness of seasickness

explanation.surface: Slang for sailor that doesn't involve feeling seasick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No' removes SEA from NAUSEA, leaving NAU, which 'in' places inside ARGOT.
explanation.definitionFit: An Argonaut was one of Jason's crew on the Argo, and by extension any sea voyager.

clue.text: Crabby cryptographer's admitting nothing

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the code inventor's name takes the zero inside

parts.note: Samuel Morse devised the Morse code
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A grumpy codebreaker admits to having nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Morose means sullen and ill-tempered, the same as crabby.

clue.text: Second part of 8, surprisingly, involves end of Tennessee Williams

indicators.note: involves means taking in, so the jumbled letters enclose the final letter
surprisingly signals the letters turn up in an unexpected order

parts.note: 8 down is MARKET RASEN; its second word is RASEN

indicators.note: end of means take the final letter of Tennessee

explanation.surface: A town's name reworked to involve the playwright Tennessee Williams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' turns RASEN into SERNA; 'involves' puts the E from 'end of Tennessee' inside. 'Tennessee Williams' suggests the playwright; the definition is just 'Williams'.
explanation.definitionFit: Serena Williams is the American tennis champion, so the answer is a Williams.

clue.text: Illicit cargo of fish concealing books by travel writer

indicators.note: concealing means the fish hides the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a cod is a fish
NT is the New Testament, a set of books
Jonathan Raban is a British travel writer

explanation.surface: A fish hides books by a travel writer, making illicit cargo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealing' puts NT and RABAN inside COD, splitting it as CO and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Contraband is smuggled goods, an illegal cargo.

clue.text: Note about a great success on the island

indicators.note: about means the note goes round the other pieces

parts.note: ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
a hit is a great success

explanation.surface: A musical note about a great success on the island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A and HIT inside TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahiti is the largest island of French Polynesia, an example of an island.

clue.text: Qualification in 60 minutes!

definitions.meaning: an academic award such as a BA
a unit of angle that splits into sixty minutes of arc

explanation.definitionFit: A university award is a degree, and one degree of arc contains sixty minutes.

clue.text: Song of mirth

definitions.meaning: a part-song for unaccompanied male voices

explanation.definitionFit: A glee is an old part-song, and the word also means merriment or delight.

clue.text: Affability of retired aristo admitting one to residence

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, going back, so the word for aristo is read backwards

parts.note: a nob is a toff, an aristocrat

indicators.note: admitting means the residence lets the one inside

parts.note: home is a residence
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A retired aristocrat lets someone into his home, showing affability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns NOB into BON; 'admitting' puts I inside HOME.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonhomie is cheerful friendliness, the same quality as affability.

clue.text: Bands injecting drug by the river

indicators.note: the gangs inject the drug, taking it inside

parts.note: bands of people are gangs
E is ecstasy, a drug

explanation.surface: Gangs shoot up drugs on a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ganges is the great sacred river of northern India.

clue.text: What's left in France is consumed

parts.note: the French for is is est
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: Asking what was left in France and was eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is the property a dead person leaves behind.

clue.text: Journalist in "Total Recall", a ghastly woman

indicators.note: in means the journalist goes inside the other pieces
recall means call back, so the word for total is read backwards

parts.note: a total is a sum
ED, short for editor, is a journalist

explanation.surface: A journalist in the film Total Recall meets a ghastly woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recall' turns SUM into MUS; with A it holds ED.
explanation.definitionFit: Medusa was the Gorgon of Greek myth with snakes for hair, a hideous woman.
